question: Hema Malini, a popular dancer and actress, received the ____________ in 2000.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hema Malini:-**

 
 
• Hema Malini is a renowned dancer and actress who has contributed significantly to the Indian film industry. She has acted in over 150 films and has won several awards for her performances.
 
• She received the Padma Shri award in the year 2000. It is the fourth highest civilian award in India. 
 
• Apart from Padma Shri, Hema Malini has also received other awards such as Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award, National Film Award for Best Actress, and NTR National Award for her contribution to Indian cinema.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri:-**
 
 
• It is awarded for distinguished service in various fields including art, literature, education, social work, medicine, science, and public affairs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Kabir Samman: **

 
 
• It is an award given by the Madhya Pradesh government for outstanding contribution in the field of literature, music, and other arts. It was first awarded in 1986.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan: **
 
 
• It is the second-highest civilian award in India, awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field including service rendered by government servants. It was instituted in 1954.
 
 
 
• **Kalidas Samman: **
 
 
• It is an annual award presented by the Madhya Pradesh government for outstanding contribution in the field of arts. It was first awarded in 1980.
